intro.h2: A tile setter who helps with the design
paragraphs: JCS Tile & Marble is the tile contractor in Port Townsend that homeowners and general contractors call when the tile has to be right. Jason does the work himself, with help from his assistant Max, and reviewers treat him as part of the design team as much as the install crew.

One couple says Jason asked all the right questions, hand selected the tile they bought and had design ideas that made the bathroom better than they had hoped. A Kala Point homeowner praised his good suggestions and fair price. Another trusted him with a tricky foyer of random slate pieces that came out beautifully. Good communication is the thread that runs through every review.

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Wall and floor tile for whole bathrooms, from the shower to the backsplash behind the vanity. Jason tiles bathrooms for homeowners directly and for general contractors who bring him in for the tile on a bigger remodel, including a bathroom at Kala Point.

image.alt: Remodeled Kala Point bathroom with tiled walk-in shower, half wall, corner bench and terrazzo-look floor tile

items.name: Walk-in showers and tub surrounds
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with built-in benches, niches and glass panels, plus tub surrounds with accent tile. Details like a patterned tile niche or a band of glass mosaic are where a good tile setter shows, and where Jason's design ideas come in.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with built-in bench, white wall tile and a band of blue glass mosaic

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: Floor tile for bathrooms, entries and living spaces, from wood-look plank tile to large-format gray porcelain. One reviewer had Jason install the wall and floor tile in two bathrooms and says he recommends him without hesitation.

image.alt: Wood-look plank floor tile beside a wood double vanity with blue glass vessel sinks

items.name: Natural stone and slate
items.blurb: Stone takes patience. Jason took on a challenging job laying random slate pieces across a foyer, fitting the irregular shapes together into a floor the homeowner says came out beautifully. Marble and other natural stone are part of the trade, and the name.

image.alt: Foyer floor of random multicolored slate pieces in rust, blue and grey tones

items.name: Patios and outdoor steps
items.blurb: Tile does not have to stop at the back door. On one covered patio, large stone-look tile runs across the slab and down the steps, giving the outdoor room the same finished look as the inside of the house, with clean edges along the lawn.

image.alt: Covered back patio and steps finished in large stone-look tile with teak dining set

about.h2: About Jason and JCS Tile & Marble
about.text: JCS Tile & Marble is a tile contractor based in Port Townsend, Washington. Jason does the work himself, often with his assistant Max, so the person you talk to about tile and layout is the person setting it. Homeowners hire him directly, and general contractors bring him in for the tile on their remodels. The work runs from full bathrooms and walk-in showers to tile floors, a covered patio and a foyer of random slate. Customers describe him as professional and pleasant to work with, with good suggestions and fair prices.

image.alt: Tub surround in blue square tile with white textured wall tile and gray floor tile

steps.title: Talk it over
steps.text: Call (360) 643-3344, any day from 9 AM to 5 PM. Jason asks about the room, how you use it and what you have in mind.

steps.title: Choose the tile
steps.text: Jason helps you pick tile and layout. One customer says he hand selected the tile they bought and added design ideas.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: Jason and his assistant set the tile and keep you updated on scheduling, materials and design while the work is underway.

steps.title: Clean up
steps.text: When the tile is done, Jason and his assistant clean up after themselves. One family said they kept the rest of the house clean throughout.

items.name: Paul L.
items.text: Jason and crew did a great job on our Kala Point bathroom remodel. Fair price -- nothing in remodeling is cheap these days. Quality work, good suggestions and pleasant to work with. Good communication.

items.name: Milly L.
items.text: Jason was selected by our general contractor during a bathroom remodel and we couldn't be more pleased. He was very professional, asked all the right questions, hand selected the tile that we bought, did an amazing job with the install and had design ideas that made the bathroom even better than we had hoped.  He and his assistant Max worked hard to keep the rest of the house clean and did a great job cleaning up after themselves when they were done. Jason communicated very well with us about scheduling, material selections, installation, the design, and answered lots of questions from us. I would highly recommend Jason for any tile job!

items.name: Kenneth C.
items.text: Jason did an excellent job on installing wall and floor tile in two bathrooms.  He also took on a challenging job of putting down random slate pieces in our foyer that came out beautifully.  I recommend him without hesitation.

service_area.h2: Tile contractor in Port Townsend and Kala Point
service_area.text: JCS Tile & Marble is listed on Google in Port Townsend, Washington, and comes to your home for the work. Past jobs include a bathroom remodel at Kala Point. If you live in or near Port Townsend and have a shower, bathroom, floor or entry that needs tile, call (360) 643-3344 any day of the week and ask whether your location is in range.

items.q: Can you help me choose tile?
items.a: Yes. Helping with tile and layout is part of how Jason works. One customer wrote that he asked all the right questions, hand selected the tile they bought and had design ideas that made their bathroom even better than they had hoped. Bring your ideas and photos and we will go from there.

items.q: Do you work with general contractors?
items.a: Yes. Jason is brought in by general contractors to handle the tile on their remodels, and he also works directly for homeowners. One family whose general contractor selected Jason said they couldn't be more pleased with the work, the communication and the clean up.

items.q: Do you install natural stone and slate?
items.a: Yes. Besides ceramic and porcelain tile in bathrooms and showers, Jason has laid a foyer of random slate pieces, a challenging job the homeowner says came out beautifully. Stone floors, entries and accents are all worth asking about when you call to talk about your project.

Google lists JCS Tile & Marble as open every day of the week, Sunday through Saturday, from 9 AM to 5 PM. Call (360) 643-3344 or email 5477rocket@gmail.com with a few photos of the space and a short description of what you want tiled.

JCS Tile & Marble is based in Port Townsend, Washington, and travels to your home for the work. One recent bathroom remodel was at Kala Point. If you are not sure whether your address is in range, call (360) 643-3344 and ask before you plan anything else.
